system_description.narrative_title: Hormuz deal talks drive oil-market swings and shipping disruption
system_description.narrative_summary: Reports and negotiations over a proposed arrangement involving Iran, Oman and (implicitly) the U.S. to regulate traffic through the Strait of Hormuz are the dominant driver of market moves in this window. Conflicting signals — official hints a deal may be close, Iran-Oman statements, and reports that the draft would give Iran control of inbound traffic — are altering shipping patterns, risk premia and commodity prices, while physical indicators (inventories, fuel stocks, vessel traffic) and regional incidents provide continual feedback. The situation is an open system where diplomatic bargaining, naval posture, commercial routing decisions and market sentiment interact and produce cascading effects on supply availability and financial asset prices.
system_description.scope: Inside the boundary: negotiations over Strait of Hormuz transit rules (Iran, Oman, U.S. signals); commercial vessel routing and traffic through Hormuz; Gulf oil export infrastructure and shipments (ports, terminals, Kharg Island); physical oil and fuel inventories and refinery throughput; commodity price discovery and related equity moves; regional security incidents and naval activity that affect transit risk.
system_description.super_system: Global energy-security and financial system (world oil market, maritime security, and international capital markets).
adjacent_subsystems: Persian Gulf regional security architecture and military deployments
Global maritime shipping, logistics and marine insurance
Downstream refining, fuel distribution and domestic fuel prices
International commodity and equity markets (risk sentiment, hedging)

variables.name: Negotiation progress
variables.description: Degree and pace of ongoing bargaining over transit rules and formal arrangements for Strait passage.

variables.name: Inbound-control degree
variables.description: Extent to which inbound vessel movements through the strait are subject to third-party control or restrictions.

variables.name: Outbound-oversight degree
variables.description: Level of monitoring or regulatory oversight applied to outbound vessel movements and cargoes leaving the strait.

variables.name: Naval presence intensity
variables.description: Concentration and operational tempo of military and paramilitary units active in and around the transit corridor.

variables.name: Vessel transit rate
variables.description: Volume of commercial vessels passing through the strait per unit time.

variables.name: Rerouting extent
variables.description: Average deviation in route distance or time caused by avoidance of the strait or alternative routing decisions.

variables.name: Transit risk premium
variables.description: Additional price or cost component attributed to perceived risk of transiting the corridor (across freight, cargo, or commodity markets).

variables.name: Crude export flow rate
variables.description: Rate of crude oil shipments originating from the regional export system passing into seaborne trade.

variables.name: Oil inventory level
variables.description: Aggregate onshore and floating crude stockpiles available in the region per unit of measurement.

variables.name: Fuel stock level
variables.description: Quantity of refined fuel products held in storage and inventories relevant to regional supply.

variables.name: Refinery throughput rate
variables.description: Volume of crude processed by regional refining capacity per unit time.

variables.name: Oil price level
variables.description: Market price level for relevant crude benchmarks that reflects supply-demand balance and risk perceptions.

variables.name: Disruption sentiment
variables.description: Market and commercial actor collective expectation about the likelihood and severity of supply interruptions.

variables.name: Insurance premium level
variables.description: Cost level of war/privateer and route-specific insurance applied to vessels and cargoes transiting the corridor.

variables.name: Market volatility level
variables.description: Degree of short-term price and return variability in commodities and related financial assets tied to the situation.

variables.name: Signal clarity level
variables.description: Consistency and ambiguity of public and private information signals about agreement terms, intentions, and enforcement.

catalysts.title: Imminent Hormuz passage deal announcement
catalysts.description: Formal announcement of a US‑Iran/Oman agreement to reopen or regulate Strait passage, expected imminently and market‑moving.
catalysts.rationale: Bessent/US officials say deal may come this week; headlines: 'deal may come this week', 'deal could be close', 'we expect a deal soon'.

catalysts.title: Iran–Oman route coordinates finalized
catalysts.description: Formal ratification or signing of the agreed coordinates/understanding between Iran and Oman for a Hormuz corridor.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Iran and Oman reach understanding on coordinates', 'Iran says it has reached agreement with Oman'.

catalysts.title: Rollout of inbound/outbound control measures
catalysts.description: Operational implementation of inbound control and outbound oversight (inspections, reporting or restrictions) envisaged in proposals.
catalysts.rationale: Sources: 'Iran demands inbound control of Hormuz and outbound oversight', 'proposed deal would give Iran control inbound'.

catalysts.title: Parliamentary review of bill to bar US/Israeli ships
catalysts.description: Iranian parliamentary committee review (and potential passage) of a draft law to ban US and Israeli vessels from Hormuz transit.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Iranian parliamentary committee reviews draft bill to bar US, Israeli ships from Hormuz'.

catalysts.title: Prolonged drop in vessel traffic through Hormuz
catalysts.description: Vessel movements remain subdued as shippers await clarity, extending reduced transit volumes and avoidance behavior.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Vessel traffic through Hormuz dwindles this week', 'traffic near standstill'.

catalysts.title: Continuation of US blockade at Kharg Island
catalysts.description: Ongoing US interdiction keeping Kharg Island export facilities idled, constraining Iran's seaborne crude exports.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Iran’s oil exports stall and Kharg Island idles under US blockade'.

catalysts.title: Shipping industry rejects proposed deal
catalysts.description: Carriers, operators and insurers publicly declare the proposed passage terms infeasible, pressuring negotiators and uptake.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Proposed Hormuz deal not feasible for shipping industry', 'sources say'.

catalysts.title: US August jobs report
catalysts.description: Scheduled US monthly jobs data release that can move financial markets and commodity risk premia.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Stocks fall ahead of Friday's US jobs data', 'Oil ticks higher... ahead of jobs report'.
